items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Because of the songs they wrote, like "Someday Sweetheart"

ctx.x: There were two very important gentleman, it seemed, called the Spikes Brothers, Johnny and Reb. Why were they so important, Mr. Blakeney, during this time and previously to 1930; the Spike Brothers, why were they so important to the music scene, and particularly to the black musicians?
Because of the songs they wrote, like "Someday Sweetheart" and others which became very popular back in those days.
Did they get employment for other musicians, within their band? Did people come to them to hire other musicians?
